title: Replace g_assert() with g_assert_true() for testing
description:
g_assert_true() is always enabled, unlike g_assert().

Bump minimum GLib 2 required version to 2.38.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -1046,7 +1046,7 @@ endmacro()

-find_package(GLIB2 "2.36.0" REQUIRED)
+find_package(GLIB2 "2.38.0" REQUIRED)
 include_directories(SYSTEM ${GLIB2_INCLUDE_DIRS})
 reset_find_package(GMODULE2)
 find_package(GMODULE2)

commits_data.title: Replace g_assert() with g_assert_true() for testing
commits_data.message:
Replace g_assert() with g_assert_true() for testing

g_assert_true() is always enabled, unlike g_assert().

Bump minimum GLib 2 required version to 2.38.
